behaviour: A due outbox row is claimed (token, generation+1, claim_until) in its own committed transaction; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on pgsql/mysql.
Each chunk runs in its own transaction under lockForUpdate of the outbox row and commits only while claim_token is still ours and status pending; a superseded worker inserts nothing.
Eligible endpoints: active, tenant null-safe equal, drive filter null or equal, subscribed, created_at <= outbox.created_at, key > fanout_cursor, ordered by key, limit fanout_chunk.
Deliveries are inserted once per (event_id, endpoint_id) (UNIQUE + existence check); jobs dispatched after commit.
The chunk with fewer than fanout_chunk endpoints completes the row (status completed, fanned_out_at, claim cleared) in the same transaction; zero subscribers -> completed, delivery_count 0.
Retry sweep: failed rows due now; pending rows only when next_retry_at <= now - relay.claim_seconds and no live claim.
Prune: outbox only completed with fanned_out_at <= threshold; deliveries only delivered|dead with updated_at <= threshold.
Legacy: migration maps dispatched -> completed + legacy_fanout + fanned_out_at=dispatched_at; vaulter:webhooks:legacy-fanout lists ambiguous rows, --replay resets them to pending.
